objective: 基于解析解与数值积分的对比，验证一维非线性薛定谔方程（NLSE）孤子解在色散与非线性平衡下的稳定性，误差容限<1e-6，10轮迭代内收敛。 假设：在适当初始条件下，数值模拟的NLSE孤子应保持形状不变且能量、动量守恒，与解析解偏差随时间增长不超过1e-6。 成功判据：数值解与解析解在t=10时的L2范数误差 < 1e-6；能量守恒相对误差 < 1e-8，动量守恒相对误差 < 1e-7 独立校验：使用已知解析解（如sech²形式）作为初始条件，通过有限差分法求解NLSE，对比数值解与解析解在多个时间点的波形与守恒量。

input_params.description: [auto-routed: 代码实验走真实执行] 1) Derive the exact 1D NLSE ground-state soliton (sech, not sech²) via symbolic Math: use `symbolic_math_tool action=pde_classify`/`pde_separation` on iψ_t + (1/2)ψ_xx + |ψ|²ψ = 0 to confirm the integrable structure, then verify by direct Ansatz substitution that ψ(x,t)=A·sech(A(x−vt))·e^{i(vx+(A²−v²)t/2)} with A·w=1 is an exact solution; explicitly document why sech² is a KdV mismatch. 2) Set up a conservative finite-difference/SSFM pipeline: choose Δx, Δt, domain L (large enough that tails are < machine precision at boundaries), with transparent/absorbing or sufficiently far Dirichlet boundaries; perform a grid-convergence study (h-refinement) to confirm the formal order of accuracy before testing the hypothesis. 3) Evolve from t=0 to t=10, recording ψ(x,t) at t=0,2,5,10; compute L2 error against the exact analytic projection on the same grid, discrete energy (L2 norm/power) and momentum, and nonlinear-solver residual per step to verify ≤10 iterations suffice. 4) Report: L2(t=10), max relative energy drift, max relative momentum drift, convergence order, and residual history; flag whether the stated tolerances are met or whether the format/initial-condition specification must be revised.
